target_customer: Enterprise marketing and creative teams that need design capacity
problem: Companies struggled to find, brief and manage reliable freelance creatives; in-house teams lacked capacity.
business_model: subscription for managed creative services delivered by a vetted global talent network

founders.name: Fredrik Thomassen
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch Dec 2021 says he comes from a marketing background and built the company after struggling to work with creatives.

technical_complexity.rationale: A project management and talent vetting platform; the work is done by people, with technology for matching and workflow.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise customers build templates and processes around the team, but creative talent networks are replicable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent acquired or copied it in sources found; later AI design tools reshaped the market.

market_need_then: The founder says he built it after struggling to find and manage creatives (TechCrunch 2021). No dated 2016 demand data was found.

branding.name_origin: Konsus was renamed Superside in 2019 because the company outgrew its original scope of everything from slide polish to landing pages; Konsus origin not found.

identity.logo: visual identity refreshed in 2025 with AI-assisted process per company account
identity.voice_and_tone: confident, tagline 'Your creative team's creative team'

branding.brand_signature: the creative team's creative team tagline

rebrands.why: company outgrew its early everything-for-hire scope, per company post
old identity fit a scrappy design service, not enterprise clients, per the company CMO account

brand_strength.rationale: Company invested in two rebrands and enterprise positioning, but sources show no community or viral effects.

pivots.from: Konsus, broad on-demand design and business tasks
pivots.to: focused subscription creative service for enterprise teams
pivots.why: narrowed focus after more than three years searching for a working model, per a profile found in search

outcome_analysis: Konsus began as a broad on-demand task marketplace, narrowed to design, and rebranded as Superside in 2019, then raised a $30M Series A in December 2021 at a reported valuation above $400M and reports 850 team members and enterprise clients. Layoff trackers list about 60 cuts in March 2026, so growth has met pressure, but no acquisition was found.
notes: Competition empty: 99designs, Fiverr and Upwork appear only in a 2021 TechCrunch article, not dated near the 2016 batch. Valuation above $400M is a TechCrunch source claim unconfirmed by company. A 2016 Konsus round (about $1.5M to $2M per ZoomInfo and startupintros aggregators, investors Acequia Capital, Slack Fund, Liquid2) is unverified; TechCrunch says about $5.5M raised before 2021, so earlier rounds are missing. A $57M Series B in 2022 appears only in a layoff tracker and could not be verified. A co-founder Sondre Rasch appears in an unopened search result and is not listed. The 2019 seed amount differs by aggregator ($3.5M vs $4M). Layoffs of about 60 in March 2026 come from trackers only.
